request.query: A real affine parameter multiplied by a natural degree and square root of natural dimension

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_smul_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_2} [inst_1 : SMulZeroClass S R] (a : S) (p : Polynomial R),
  (a • p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree

items.name: CFC.sqrt_eq_rpow
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder A] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : StarRing A] [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace A]
  [inst_4 : StarOrderedRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra ℝ A] [inst_6 : ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint]
  [inst_7 : NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [T2Space A] {a : A}, CFC.sqrt a = a ^ (1 / 2)
